necroids.2.en: About 9.4 years after start (once the capital meets the conditions): the Elevation Ceremony

opening.evidence: game_start.33 (events/game_start.txt) fires necroids.2 after 3420 days for a non-purifier necrophage empire (events/necroids_events_1.txt:191-231); its own trigger needs a capital older than 8 years with building_necrophage_elevation_chamber and an assigned necro_apprentice. Hidden support: necroids.1 (on_colony_10_year_pulse common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3959), 3 (:3871), 4 (on_game_start_country :36), 5 (on_pop_purged :3305), 6, 10, 15, 25.

uncertain: The elevation mechanic (necrophage_elevation_chamber, necro_apprentice job) lives in buildings and jobs; only the announcement window is an event.
